children: Italy posted a 2025 budget deficit of 3.1% of gross domestic product, statistics bureau ISTAT said on Tuesday, confirming previous data and dashing Rome's hopes of exiting a European Union disciplinary procedure for its "excessive" deficit.
The deficit figure, contained in ISTAT's official notification to the European Commission, is lower than the 3.4% deficit-to-GDP reading in 2024 but just above the European Union's 3% limit.

The data is a blow for Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni's government which had hoped for a downward revision that would have set the seal on Rome's fiscal consolidation ahead of an election scheduled in 2027.
